new_ROM: Main character ROM is self-contained initial data in operator_ui_text.v; no external mem file.
constraints_policy: All old constraints unchanged; main SDC may only append a reviewed exact operator mailbox block.
r3_area_scope: Purpose-exclusive pending job/centre storage and exact-range timeout/ms counters; all payload IDs and UART/model semantics retained. Original packet timeout and CRC rules unchanged.
r8_area_scope: Cycle-equivalent diagnostic LED counter sharing and common unsigned 16-bit X-mirror subtraction. No model, protocol, UART, safety FSM or constraint change.
r9_area_scope: Source-bounded HXA scan_word 17-bit, tx_at/result_copy_at 8-bit; same protocol, payload lengths, CRC steps, timeouts and reset-reachable cycle behavior. No frame, write-task, model, safety or constraint semantics changed.
